subchannels.name: The written dispatch
subchannels.scene_or_process: A written artifact is delivered from above, enters voiced dispute, and presents a fixed claim.
subchannels.synthesis: The Book is not only information but a dispatched written object. Its descent gives it a direction of delivery, while its entry into speech makes the human accusation answer an already materialized record whose content stands fixed.

subchannels.active_motifs: cutting for repair and sewing (quranic:root_001150:B001/m01); fabricated lie (quranic:root_001150:B003/m01); tightly woven speech (quranic:root_000347:B010/m01); disturbed doubt (quranic:root_000616:B001/m01); warning that awakens caution (quranic:root_001488:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:2 `ريب` (ر ي ب); 32:3 `افتراه` (ف ر ي), `الحق` (ح ق ق), `لتنذر` and `نذير` (ن ذ ر)
subchannels.name: Counterfeit seams and the alarm
subchannels.scene_or_process: A counterfeit utterance is cut and pieced together, while sound workmanship and an alarm expose its instability.
subchannels.synthesis: The accusation of fabrication activates both false invention and the older craft-image of cutting material for repair. Against that pieced counterfeit stands speech imagined as tightly made; the warning then functions like an alarm that agitates settled doubt into caution.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:2-3 names the descending Book (`تنزيل`, `الكتاب`), the accusation of fabrication (`افتراه`), the truth (`الحق`), and the warning (`لتنذر`, `نذير`).
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The contrast between revelation and forgery acquires the material language of writing, cutting, sewing, and tightly finished workmanship.

parent_channels.name: P1 (32:1-10) Vertical Governance
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Creation is an ordered vertical polity: an overhead structure rests above a lower field, affairs are measured, and authority circulates without an independent deputy.

subchannels.active_motifs: bringing creation into being (quranic:root_000434:B002/m01); overhead canopy (quranic:root_000745:B004/m01); lower ground (quranic:root_000025:B001/m01); interval between things (quranic:root_000170:B002/m01); raised shelter or roof (quranic:root_001000:B002/m01); elevated settled position (quranic:root_000766:B003/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:4 `خلق` (خ ل ق), `السماوات` (س م و), `الأرض` (ء ر ض), `بينهما` (ب ي ن), `استوى` (س و ي), `العرش` (ع ر ش)
subchannels.name: Canopy, ground, and raised seat
subchannels.scene_or_process: An overhead canopy and lower ground define an inhabited interval beneath a raised seat.
subchannels.synthesis: Heaven becomes the covering member of a built environment, earth its lower foundation, and the space between them an articulated interval. The throne contributes both roof-like elevation and settled height, making rule spatially legible.

subchannels.active_motifs: measurement before making (quranic:root_000434:B001/m01); planning by the outcome (quranic:root_000458:B006/m01); administered affair (quranic:root_000051:B001/m01); bounded amount (quranic:root_001205:B001/m01); calculated preparation (quranic:root_001205:B005/m01); enumeration (quranic:root_000989:B001/m01); duration (quranic:root_001700:B002/m01); six as counted number (quranic:root_000673:B001/m01); thousand as aggregate number (quranic:root_000045:B001/m01); year as measured term (quranic:root_000751:B008/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:4 `خلق` (خ ل ق), `ستة` (س ت ت), `أيام` (ي و م); 32:5 `يدبر` (د ب ر), `الأمر` (ء م ر), `يوم` (ي و م), `مقداره` (ق د ر), `ألف` (ء ل ف), `سنة` (س ن و), `تعدون` (ع د د)
subchannels.name: Measured administration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A maker estimates, plans toward outcomes, bounds quantities, and counts the temporal scale of an affair.
subchannels.synthesis: Creation and administration share one calculating operation. Estimation precedes making, foresight follows the affair to its outcome, and days, years, and thousands become interoperable units in a governance whose scale exceeds ordinary counting.

subchannels.active_motifs: royal seat (quranic:root_001000:B001/m01); office and authority (quranic:root_000051:B003/m01); height and elevation (quranic:root_000745:B001/m01); ascent to a higher level (quranic:root_000997:B004/m01); lower ground (quranic:root_000025:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:4 `العرش` (ع ر ش); 32:5 `الأمر` (ء م ر), `السماء` (س م و), `الأرض` (ء ر ض), `يعرج` (ع ر ج)
subchannels.name: The ascending circuit
subchannels.scene_or_process: Authority occupies a raised seat, directs an affair across the vertical interval, and receives its ascent.
subchannels.synthesis: The affair moves through a vertical administrative circuit. The throne supplies the seat of office, heaven and earth establish its levels, and ascent figures the return leg of an ordered transmission rather than undirected motion.

subchannels.active_motifs: other-than or lesser rank (quranic:root_000502:B003/m01); proximity without a gap (quranic:root_001684:B001/m01); caretaker holding office (quranic:root_001684:B003/m01); allied supporter (quranic:root_001684:B004/m01); adding a second to a single party (quranic:root_000802:B001/m01); intercessor joining another's case (quranic:root_000802:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:4 `دونه` (د و ن), `ولي` (و ل ي), `شفيع` (ش ف ع)
subchannels.name: No secondary sponsor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A court lacks any adjacent caretaker, allied sponsor, or second party who can join another's plea.
subchannels.synthesis: Protector and intercessor are not generic helpers. One would stand near enough to administer or support; the other would make an isolated petitioner into a pair. Their absence leaves the vertical government without a parallel office or supplementary advocate.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:4-5 joins creation of heaven and earth, the throne, the absence of protector or intercessor, measured administration, and ascent.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic order is rendered simultaneously as architecture, metrology, administration, and a court in which no secondary patron can be added.

parent_channels.name: P1 (32:1-10) Living Manufacture
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Human life is assembled through successive operations on material: measuring and moulding, extracting a lineage, pneumatic animation, and installation of responsive faculties.

subchannels.name: The moulded form
subchannels.scene_or_process: Mixed clay is measured, begun, formed, and brought to a finished, straightened state.
subchannels.synthesis: Clay is both physical mixture and a mould-like constitution. Measurement precedes making, beginning opens the production sequence, and straightening completes a form whose excellence is the excellence of workmanship.

subchannels.name: The extracted lineage
subchannels.scene_or_process: A continuing lineage is gently drawn from an apparently weak generative fluid.
subchannels.synthesis: Lineage is not a bulk transfer but an extraction: an essence is slipped from a source and made into descendants. The fluid's lexical weakness intensifies the transformation, since durable succession emerges from material presented as slight and ineffectual.

subchannels.active_motifs: straightened and completed form (quranic:root_000766:B002/m01); sending air into a body (quranic:root_001529:B001/m01); expansion by filling with air (quranic:root_001529:B002/m01); life-soul of the body (quranic:root_000609:B001/m01); wind and moving air (quranic:root_000609:B003/m01)

subchannels.name: Pneumatic animation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A completed form receives moving air, expands, and becomes a living body.
subchannels.synthesis: The breathed spirit preserves both sides of one operation: wind is sent into a shaped enclosure, the enclosure expands, and the life-principle occupies it. Animation is thus rendered as pneumatic filling rather than an abstract addition.

subchannels.active_motifs: auditory perception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); ear as receiving aperture (quranic:root_000741:B002/m01); visual perception (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); inward insight (quranic:root_000121:B002/m01); furnace heat and firing (quranic:root_001122:B001/m01); heart as inner ignition (quranic:root_001122:B002/m01); scarcity (quranic:root_001251:B001/m01); grateful recognition (quranic:root_000810:B001/m01); a body thriving on little feed (quranic:root_000810:B002/m01)

subchannels.name: Sensorium and heated center
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hearing and sight feed perception into an internally heated center that should answer provision with gratitude.
subchannels.synthesis: Ear, eye, and inward vision form an intake system centered on the heart's old image of heat and firing. The rebuke of "little" gratitude is sharpened by the same-root image of an organism that converts a small ration into visible flourishing: the installed faculties receive much but yield little response.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:7-9 moves from clay creation through extracted fluid to shaping, spirit-breath, hearing, sight, hearts, and gratitude.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The person appears as a crafted, inflated, sensor-equipped body whose inner heart retains the heat of a furnace and whose response should make a small input productive.

parent_channels.name: P2 (32:11-20) Inversion into Recognition
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Final presence reverses bodily orientation and converts previously ineffective senses into certain recognition and a desire for repair.

subchannels.active_motifs: offense and transgression (quranic:root_000239:B004/m01); bodily mass (quranic:root_000239:B007/m01); turning top into bottom (quranic:root_001551:B001/m01); lowered head and gaze (quranic:root_001551:B006/m01); head as bodily top (quranic:root_000529:B001/m01); near presence (quranic:root_001052:B004/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:12 `المجرمون` (ج ر م), `ناكسوا` (ن ك س), `رؤوسهم` (ر ء س), `عند` (ع ن د)
subchannels.name: The inverted body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Offenders become embodied masses whose top is turned downward in the immediate presence of authority.
subchannels.synthesis: The social identity "offenders" becomes materially embodied, then its highest member is turned down. Presence is not merely locative: it is the setting in which rank and bodily orientation are visibly reversed.

subchannels.active_motifs: visual perception (quranic:root_000121:B001/m01); inward insight (quranic:root_000121:B002/m01); auditory perception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); understanding what is heard (quranic:root_000741:B003/m01); compliance with what is heard (quranic:root_000741:B003/m02); settled certainty (quranic:root_001696:B001/m01); return to a former state (quranic:root_000544:B001/m01); relapse into a former condition (quranic:root_001551:B003/m01); intentional work (quranic:root_001046:B001/m01); repair and soundness (quranic:root_000876:B001/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:12 `أبصرنا` (ب ص ر), `سمعنا` (س م ع), `فارجعنا` (ر ج ع), `نعمل` (ع م ل), `صالحا` (ص ل ح), `موقنون` (ي ق ن); `ناكسوا` (ن ك س)
subchannels.name: Senses lock onto repair
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sight becomes insight, hearing becomes compliance, and certainty generates a request to reverse course and perform repair.
subchannels.synthesis: Seeing and hearing are redefined by their successful outcomes: insight, compliance, and certainty. The requested return resembles the reversal of a relapse, but its stated purpose is practical repair, making recognition inseparable from the work it came too late to initiate.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:12 shows offenders with lowered heads who now see, hear, become certain, and ask to return for sound action.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Bodily inversion and relapse belong to the same corrective frame: the condemned seek another reversal only after their sensory system has become operative.

parent_channels.name: P2 (32:11-20) Abandonment Becomes Enforced Experience
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What was dropped from memory returns as an inescapable bodily experience.

subchannels.active_motifs: lapse from memory (quranic:root_001501:B001/m01); deliberate abandonment (quranic:root_001501:B002/m01); discarded and negligible object (quranic:root_001501:B003/m01); face-to-face encounter (quranic:root_001372:B004/m01); what one encounters of harm (quranic:root_001372:B007/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:14 `نسيتم` and `نسيناكم` (ن س ي), `لقاء` (ل ق ي)
subchannels.name: The discarded encounter
subchannels.scene_or_process: An awaited meeting is allowed to fall from memory and is treated like negligible baggage.
subchannels.synthesis: Forgetting is not only cognitive failure. Its lexical tail turns the encounter into an item thrown aside during departure, and the reciprocal abandonment answers that treatment by making the discarded meeting arrive as harmful encounter.

subchannels.active_motifs: oral tasting (quranic:root_000526:B001/m01); experienced ordeal (quranic:root_000526:B002/m01); bodily abstention from food and drink (quranic:root_000994:B002/m01); withholding or weaning from a thing (quranic:root_000994:B003/m01); painful punishment (quranic:root_000994:B005/m01); enduring persistence (quranic:root_000429:B001/m01); clinging and remaining in place (quranic:root_000429:B002/m01)
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 32:14 `فذوقوا` and `ذوقوا` (ذ و ق), `عذاب` (ع ذ ب), `الخلد` (خ ل د)
subchannels.name: Forced taste and adhesion
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body that could abstain from food or drink is made to experience pain as taste and remain attached to it.
subchannels.synthesis: The command to taste forces bodily contact with what cannot nourish. The punishment root also evokes abstention and weaning, while perpetuity adds adhesion: the sufferers cannot refuse intake and cannot detach from its consequence.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:14 makes forgotten encounter answerable by reciprocal abandonment and repeated tasting of enduring punishment.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: A neglected encounter becomes a discarded object, while punishment reverses voluntary abstention by compelling taste and lasting attachment.

parent_channels.name: P2 (32:11-20) The Night Economy of Release and Reserve
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and possessions move outward in present devotion while compensating refreshment remains concealed for later disclosure.

subchannels.name: Bodies leave their beds
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sides detach from sleeping surfaces, rise into vocal invocation, and remain suspended between fear and desire.
subchannels.synthesis: The devotional act begins as a precise contact change: the body's side ceases to adhere to its resting place. That physical separation opens a vocal relation whose two tensions are expected harm and desired good.

subchannels.name: Provision passes outward
subchannels.scene_or_process: Assigned sustenance leaves possession through expenditure figured as a passage with a hidden outlet.
subchannels.synthesis: Provision is first apportioned inwardly as food or rain, then deliberately sent outward as expenditure. The tunnel-image in the expenditure root gives that transfer a mechanism: value disappears from one enclosure because it has passed through an outlet toward another.

subchannels.name: The hidden cool reserve
subchannels.scene_or_process: A concealed recompense rests like cool water that settles and refreshes the eye.
subchannels.synthesis: The reward is concealed, but its effect is sensorially concrete: coldness stills the eye. The eye's own spring-sense extends the image into a covered reservoir whose eventual flow answers present work with a precisely matched refreshment.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:16-17 joins bodies leaving beds, invocation in fear and hope, expenditure from provision, and a hidden recompense that cools the eyes.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Expenditure becomes passage through an outlet, and the unseen reward takes the form of a cool, covered water-source held in reserve.

parent_channels.name: P2 (32:11-20) Opposed Refuges
parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Moral difference is materialized as two incompatible enclosures, one receiving its occupants as guests and the other defeating every attempted exit.

subchannels.name: Garden lodging

subchannels.name: The fire that defeats emergence
subchannels.scene_or_process: One who has broken outward seeks to leave a fiery refuge but is repeatedly put back into its painful experience.
subchannels.synthesis: The same-root image of a ripe date escaping its skin gives transgression the shape of premature emergence. The fire reverses that freedom: every intended exit becomes a return, and rejected truth becomes the ordeal the occupants must repeatedly experience.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:18-20 denies equality, assigns believers garden lodging, and assigns the transgressors a fire to which they are repeatedly returned.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The transgressor's root evokes ripe fruit slipping from its peel, yet the fire turns that image of emergence into a futile escape cycle.

parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 32:23-24 presents the given Book as guidance and appoints leaders who guide by command through patience and certainty.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The leader is also a builder's line or supporting plank, so transmitted guidance becomes an architecture that aligns later movement.

parent_channels.name: S18. Whole-surah: The Decoy's Pleasant Call
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A calling bird is placed inside a net, sends an attractive repeated sound outward, and draws other listeners toward capture.
parent_channels.synthesis: The trap usefully pressures the surah's repeated hearing scenes. A pleasant, detectable call can be deliberately engineered to draw its hearer into confinement, so auditory reception alone does not establish guidance. Against the accusation of fabrication in 32:3, the scene sharpens the need to distinguish a true warning by its source and outcome from a voice that attracts only to capture.

parent_channels.name: S19. P1-P2-P3 [Causal sequence]: Commissioned Work Reaches Settlement
parent_channels.scene_or_process: An affair receives an appointed time, is entrusted to supervised skilled labor under written guarantee, and ends when its fixed compensation is restored as the worker's right.
parent_channels.synthesis: Across P1 -> P2 -> P3, the bridge is a causal sequence. The lexical contract materializes the surah's relation between deed and outcome: recompense is neither arbitrary gift nor arbitrary injury, but the due result of assigned work, held under guarantee and finally returned to its owner.

parent_channels.name: S20. P1-P2-P3 [Role reversal]: The Accuser Enters the Hearing
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A speaker attributes false words, advances a claim, enters negotiation and sharp dispute, receives a returned answer, and moves from accuser to claimant under an imposed ruling.
parent_channels.synthesis: Across P1 -> P2 -> P3, the bridge is a reversal of discourse roles. Claim, negotiation, returned answer, acknowledgement or denial, and imposed ruling form one hearing: those who first judge the message end as the parties judged by its answer.

parent_channels.scene_or_process: Hunters set out with a tested bow and attached quiver, bring down edible game, inspect whether it has died, and use the slaughtering knife if life remains so that prey does not become unslaughtered carrion.
parent_channels.synthesis: The hunt makes the passage from death to food depend on examination and a correct finishing act; impact alone does not settle the prey's status. الٓمٓ
تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّۢ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ذَٰلِكَ عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ مِن طِينٍۢ
ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَءَاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ

أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ

وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
